attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.description: `true` if the button should have input focus when the page loads.

attributes.name: batch-action
attributes.description: `true` if the button is being used within a data table batch action toolbar

attributes.name: button-class-name
attributes.description: Specify an optional className to be added to your Button

attributes.name: danger-description
attributes.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger button variants

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Specify whether the Button should be disabled, or not

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: The default file name, used if this button is rendered as `<a>`.

attributes.name: clear-selection-label
attributes.description: The `aria-label` attribute for the icon to clear selection.

attributes.name: input-label
attributes.description: The `aria-label` attribute for the `<input>` for filtering.

attributes.name: should-filter-item
attributes.description:
Provide custom filtering behavior. This attribute will be ignored if
`typeahead` is enabled and will default to `true`

attributes.name: typeahead
attributes.description: **Experimental**: will enable autocomplete and typeahead for the input field.

attributes.name: allow-custom-value
attributes.description: `true` to allow custom values that do not match any item in the list.

attributes.description:
